why: Step B of the customization-matrix rows host-switch and port-forwarding (Leo 2026-11-19: "'parity' means stuff like being able to add hosts and whatnot to the sidebar"): binds the four catalog actions machine.switch/portForward/portList/portClose. The wire format, request encoding, decoding and the SSH link's admin client are already in CmuxNextRemote (SSHLinkAdmin, SSHLinkPorts, SSHMachineLink.linkAdmin). What stays in the App is what reads App-only types: the handlers read SSHMachineSession, AppActionContext, CloudHandlers.answer and the RemoteStrings tables, Switch Host reads AppServices.hostsSidebar and WindowManager, and the palette source reads AppServices.hostsSidebar. They cannot move without a CmuxNextRemote dependency on CmuxNextApp types.
author: host-switch step B lane (claude sonnet 5.5)
